name: Storm Exploration Inc.
summary: Storm Exploration Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mining properties. It holds a 100% interest in the North Kimberley diamond project located in the King George River region of Western Australia. The company was formerly known as Lithoquest Diamonds Inc. and changed its name to Storm Exploration Inc. in November 2020. Storm Exploration Inc. is headquartered in Salt Spring Island, Canada.
